preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 100000 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each of the T subsequent lines contains a string s composed of lowercase letters (a-z) with length 1 ≤ |s| ≤ 100000.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(sum(len(s) - len(p) + 1 for p in all_substrings(s) for _ in range(count_substring(s, p)))) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.split()[1:]]]
postconditions.description: For each string s, the output is a line containing the self-similarity value, defined as the sum over all nonempty substrings p of s of (len(s) - len(p) + 1) multiplied by the number of occurrences of p in s as a substring.
